[[Wolfeboro, New Hampshire]] | career_highlights = | awards = *2012 [[Conference USA Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Conference USA Player of the Year]] | honors = *2011 Conference USA All-Freshman Team. *2012 1st Team All-Conference USA | championships = Y | championship_list = *[[2011 Conference USA Men's Basketball Tournament|2011 C-USA Tournament]] *[[2012 Conference USA Men's Basketball Tournament|2012 C-USA Tournament]] | tournaments =Y | tournament_list = *[[2011 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2011 NCAA]] *[[2012 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2012 NCAA]] }} '''William Denard "Will" Barton''' (born January 6, 1991) is an American [[college basketball]] player at the [[University of Memphis]]. He plays [[Shooting guard]]. During his sophomore, Barton won the Conference USA player of the year[http://www.conferenceusa.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/030712aab.html Barton of Memphis Take Top C-USA Honor] becoming the first Memphis player to win since [[Chris Douglas-Roberts]] in 2008. He is projected to be a late first or early second round draft pick in the [[2012 NBA Draft]].[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Will-Barton-5737/ DraftExpress.com] ==High School career== Barton was a highly touted recruit coming out of [[Brewster Academy]]. Barton was rated the best shooting guard by [[Scout.com]] and [[ESPN.com]] in 2010[http://scouthoops.scout.com/a.z?s=75&p=9&c=4&cfg=bb&pid=41&yr=2010 Scout.com College Basketball Team Recruiting Prospects][http://espn.go.com/college-sports/basketball/recruiting/playerrankings/_/position/shooting-guard/class/2010/view/position ESPN Basketball Recruiting Player Rankings] Barton chose Memphis over [[University of Arizona|Arizona]], [[University of Maryland, College Park|Maryland]], [[University of Kentucky|Kentucky]], [[Indiana University|Indiana]], and [[Villanova University|Villanova]].[http://espn.go.com/college-sports/basketball/recruiting/player/_/id/56012/will-barton ESPN Recruiting profile] Barton was invited to play in the [[Jordan Brand Classic]] in 2010.[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncaa/recruiting/basketball/mens/news/story?id=4925158 Barton ready for the Garden] {{College Athlete Recruit Start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2010}} {{College Athlete Recruit Entry | recruit = Will Barton | position = [[Shooting guard|G]] | hometown = Baltimore, Maryland | highschool = [[Brewster Academy]] | feet = 6 | inches = 6 | weight = 170 | 40 = | commitdate = 2009-06-6 | rivals stars = 5 | scout stars = 5 | espn grade = 97 }} {{College Athlete Recruit End | 40 = | year = 2010 | rivals ref title = Memphis Basketball Commitments | scout ref title = 2010 Memphis Basketball Commits | espn ref title = ESPN | rivals school = 101 | scout s = 350 | espn schoolid = 235 | scout overall = 12 | rivals overall = 11 | espn overall = 8 | accessdate = 2012-06-01 | bball = yes }} ==Collegiate career== Barton came to Memphis in 2010 and played every game. He lead the Tigers in minutes with 30.6 and lead the Tigers in scoring with 12.3 points per game.[http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/team/stats/_/id/235/year/2011/memphis-tigers Memphis Tigers Stats - 2010-11] Barton had a breakout sophomore season leading the Tigers in points per game and rebounds per game average 18 and 8 en route to winning C-USA Player of the Year.[http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/team/stats/_/id/235/year/2012/memphis-tigers Memphis Tigers Stats - 2011-12] ==Professional career== In March 2012, Barton decided to forgo his final two years of eligibility and declare for the [[2012 NBA Draft]].[ http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2012/story/_/id/7723474/memphis-tigers-guard-barton-declare-draft-source-says Will Barton to declare for draft] ==References== {{Reflist}} ==Exteranl links== *[http://www.gotigersgo.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/barton_will00.html Memphis Tigers bio] {{Conference USA Men's Basketball Player of the Year navbox}} {{Persondata | NAME = Barton, Will | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = Basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = January 6, 1991 | PLACE OF BIRTH = [[Baltimore]], [[Maryland]] | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Barton, Will}} [[Category:1991 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from Maryland]] [[Category:Memphis Tigers men's basketball players]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Baltimore, Maryland]]
